headline: Is Cintas (CTAS) Fairly Valued After Its Leadership Reshuffle?
summary: Cintas (CTAS) recently drew investor attention after separating the roles of president and chief executive officer and appointing Jim Rozakis as president and COO, while Todd Schneider continues as CEO. See our latest analysis for Cintas. At a share price of $203.05, Cintas has delivered a 30 day share price return of 12.7% and a 90 day share price return of 21.6%, while the 1 year total shareholder return has declined 9.4% and the 5 year total shareholder return is 118%.
